name: Ritz-Carlton, Masai Mara Safari Camp
positioning: Tented suite safari camp (officially The Ritz-Carlton, Masai Mara Safari Camp) along the Sand River in the Masai Mara National Reserve
best_for: Travelers who want a safari with a private butler and daily game drives
Families with children aged six and over

facts.text: The camp sits among trees in the heart of the Masai Mara National Reserve.
Each suite is positioned along the Sand River in the Masai Mara.
The suites have private decks, plunge pools and personalized butler service.
The butler service is called Encholiek, a Maasai word for someone who walks alongside you.
The two-bedroom suites are described as ideal for families, with treetop views.
Stays include two game drives a day in a private open-air Safari Land Cruiser with certified guides.
The guides are certified by the Kenya Professional Safari Guides Association.
Nest is the main restaurant, with a restaurant deck, a private wine cellar, a sky deck for stargazing dinners and a Boma experience.
The private wine cellar offers tastings guided by a sommelier.
Whispering Tree Spa treatments use Acacia, Shea Butter and Aloe and draw on Maasai healing traditions.
The Wellness Hub has an open-air heated pool, a gym and a studio.

highlights.text: Each suite is raised above the ground, so wildlife can roam freely below.
At dusk a Masai Moran sounds a traditional horn to mark the transition from day to night.
The Kenya-Tanzania Border Stone, a marker linking the Masai Mara and Serengeti, is steps away from the camp.
The Boma dinner is a fireside evening with storytelling, traditional Masai dances and a feast.

considerations.text: The camp has a minimum age requirement of six years.
The quickest way to reach the camp is by air, to the Keekorok airstrip, followed by a game drive to the camp.
WhataHotel notes limited availability during certain months.
